subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• In 2018, marine biology professor Amaka Nnaji and her students from Pacific Coast University made a discovery.
• The team found a new coral species in the waters off the California coast.
• The coral forms distinctive bright orange colonies in shallow reef environments.
• The new species was named Pacificora to recognize the university where the discoverers worked.
prompt: The student wants to explain the origin of the species' name. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Pacificora, a new coral species discovered in 2018, forms distinctive bright orange colonies in shallow reef environments.
choices.B: A new coral species found in the waters off the California coast was named Pacificora.
choices.C: The new species was named Pacificora to recognize Pacific Coast University, where the discoverers worked.
choices.D: Pacificora, a coral species that forms bright orange colonies, was discovered in 2018 by marine biologist Amaka Nnaji and her university students.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. It explains where the coral's name came from.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. This choice does not explain the origin of the coral's name.
